resources.string_add: Check that the server meets the requirements and that UNA can write to its folders.
Connect to an empty MySQL or MariaDB database.
Name the site, check its address and create your admin account.
Choose the apps to start with.
UNA installs the apps one at a time.
Set up scheduled jobs and open your site.
All set: UNA can write to every folder it needs.
Scheduled jobs already run: the Docker setup's cron service starts periodic/cron.php every minute.
resources.string_upd: This sets up UNA on this server in six steps. It takes a few minutes.
Steps 2 to 4: the database, your site and admin account, then the apps.
Every table of the site uses this engine. InnoDB, the default, keeps your data safe when the server stops unexpectedly.
Delete the install folder from the server. The site opens once it's gone.
Delete the install folder from the server, then reload this page. After that, open Studio to add apps and set up the site.
